# A binding modal written plain

`Policy: pol-BOLD` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

The obligation is there and the word is right. Written plain it reads at the weight of a recommendation, and a
reader skimming a long table takes the weight in before the words.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exists so `clause-modal` is exercised on its emphasis branch.

## Clauses

| Id      | Clause                                      |
|---------|---------------------------------------------|
| `CLEAN` | MUST trigger `clause-modal` and nothing else |
